backfillDays.title: Days of mail to fetch on the first sync

clientSetup.appTypeNote: Register an app in Microsoft Entra (Azure portal) and add the Mobile and desktop applications platform — a public client needs no client secret. Any loopback port works for the redirect.
steps: Sign in at portal.azure.com and open Microsoft Entra ID, then App registrations, then New registration.
For supported account types choose 'Accounts in any organizational directory and personal Microsoft accounts'.
Under Authentication, add the 'Mobile and desktop applications' platform and enable the loopback redirect — any 127.0.0.1 port works.
No client secret is needed: this registration is a public client.
Copy the Application (client) ID from the Overview page and paste it below.

notes: Work/school accounts in the 'organizations' Azure AD tenant. A window, not a mirror: the first sync of each folder fetches the last backfillDays days of mail (default 90; Microsoft caps a filtered first sync at 5,000 messages per folder), a batch at a time; after that every new message arrives, and read/unread changes refresh the messages already synced. Messages later moved out of the folder or deleted stay in the corpus. Sending is deny-by-default: only recipients on the binding's allowed recipients/domains lists can be sent to, and night shift defers sends to the outbox for daytime approval. Saving a draft files the message in Drafts for you to review and send yourself; it never transmits, so it needs no allowlist. Drafts need the Mail.ReadWrite permission this version requests: accounts linked with an earlier version must be re-linked before saving drafts works.
